name: Twitch + Discord browser
postAttachCommand: docker rm -f browser >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --name browser --restart unless-stopped --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --shm-size=1gb -e PUID=1000 -e PGID=1000 -e TZ=Etc/UTC -e TITLE='Twitch + Discord' -e CHROME_CLI='--autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required https://www.twitch.tv https://discord.com/app' -v browser-config:/config -p 3000:3000 lscr.io/linuxserver/chromium:latest
